synopsis: After October 7th the world was shocked and sympathetic following the Hamas attacks in Israel. Within a few short months most of this sympathy had gone as the world recoiled in horror at the brutality of the Israeli response to these attacks, while 73% of Israeli Jews expressed support for this response. As a British-American Jew Gillian wanted to know what has happened to make these Jews, a people who have experienced oppression, othering, and genocide, exhibit such moral and humanitarian numbn
tmdb_overview: Why do 73% of Jewish Israelis support the destruction of Gaza?  Directed by BAFTA winning filmmaker Gillian Mosely, 'Planet Israel' answers this question.  Within a few short months after October 7, most of global sympathy towards Israel evaporated as the world recoiled in horror at the brutality of the Israeli response to these attacks, while few Israeli Jews seem to have noticed anything untoward.  As a British/American Jew, Gillian Mosely wanted to know what has happened to make Jews, a people who have experienced oppression, othering, and genocide, exhibit such moral and humanitarian numbness. More widely, how does the moral disengagement that allows atrocities the world over, happen? Gillian thought she was making a film about trauma. But the reality turned out to be so much darker than she’d imagined as the mechanisms behind our disintegrating democracies and international laws are exposed.

tmdb_overview: Singer-songwriter Paul Simon had been on the cutting-edge of pop music throughout most of the 1960s and the '70s, first as half of the seminal folk-rock duo Simon & Garfunkel, and then as a well-received solo artist. But the rise of 1980s rock and new wave saw a decline in Simon's commercial success, and the singer responded by experimenting with different musical styles--most notably, world beat--that culminated in his adventurous 1986 masterpiece GRACELAND. The album's fusion of American folk-rock songwriting and buoyant South African rhythms not only broke new ground in pop music, but became Simon's biggest-selling solo record. This episode of the CLASSIC ALBUMS series examines the making of Simon's groundbreaking work through interviews, behind-the-scenes footage, music videos, and live performances of album tracks such as "Boy in the Bubble," "Diamonds on the Soles of Her Shoes," "You Can Call Me Al," and "Under African Skies."

Daredevil. Rebel. Powerhouse. At 39, Yuja Wang stands among the most electrifying musicians of our time and she is falling out of love with the music. Genre(s): DramaUK/Ireland/Cyprus | 2026 | 112 minsDirector: Morgan MatthewsStars: Loré Adewusi, Dexter Sol Ansell, Eoin Duffy, Clare Dunne, Roman Griffin Davis, Deirdre Monaghan, Bill Nighy, David Ryan, Harleen Sahota, Michael Socha.Our 2pm screening includes descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss and will be followed by a post screening discussion with the Croydon U3A film group. In this emotional and involving drama, Finn and his brother
Charlie run away from their Yorkshire home to escape the turmoil of their
fractured family life and avoid being separated from each other by their
divorcing parents. Carried along by their own quick wits and the kindness of
strangers, they head to the wild west coast of Ireland, the home of their
beloved but estranged grandfather. This life affirming road movie is cleverly
interwoven with flashbacks of joyful memories and features outstanding performances
from a multi generational cast.
tmdb_overview: A broken family is forced to come together when 16-year-old Finn and his livewire younger brother Charlie run away from trouble at home in England to reach their estranged grandfather on Ireland’s stunning and wild west coast.

synopsis:
A Private Life 
Genre(s): Drama/MysteryFrance | 2026 | 107 mins (French with English Subtitles)Director: Rebecca ZlotowskiCast: Jodie Foster, Daniel Auteuil, Virginie Efira
Foster plays Lilian
Steiner, an American
psychiatrist adrift in Paris —
divorced, estranged from her son, and losing herself in her patients' troubles.
When one of her patients is found dead in an apparent suicide, Steiner can't let it go. Armed with little more
than professional instinct and the reluctant company of her ex-husband played
by Daniel Auteil, she begins to dig. What unfolds is part Hitchcockian thriller
and part wry relationship comedy.
This film contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy
tmdb_overview: The renowned psychiatrist Lilian Steiner mounts a private investigation into the death of one of her patients, whom she is convinced has been murdered.

synopsis:
An American in Paris 
Genre(s): Romance/MusicalUSA | 1951 | 113 minsDirector: Vincente MinnelliStars: Gene Kelly, Leslie Caron, Oscar Levant
Based
on George Gershwin’s tone poem of the same name, which accompanies the ballet
sequence at the film’s climax, as well as songs from the Gershwin catalogue,
this multi-Oscar winning musical stars Kelly as Jerry, a WWII veteran
struggling to succeed as an artist, who falls for Lise (Caron), without
realising she is the girlfriend of his best friend, French singer Henri. Among
other delights in the film is a sequence where Oscar Levant dreams of playing
Gershwin’s Piano Concerto in F – and becomes the conductor, the other musicians
and even a member of the audience!
tmdb_overview: Jerry Mulligan is an exuberant American expatriate in Paris trying to make a reputation as a painter. His friend Adam is a struggling concert pianist who's a long time associate of a famous French singer, Henri Baurel. A lonely society woman, Milo Roberts, takes Jerry under her wing and supports him, but is interested in more than his art.

synopsis:
Animal Shorts + activities

The morning starts with Cinemini (nature inspired events for
toddlers). At 12pm we will screen a selection of short films featuring animals.
From a lynx exploring the city to a tiny fox discovering the magic of growing
things, these films invite us to join the world of our animal friends. After
the screening, children can create their own miniature animal habitats using
natural materials and found objects, including twigs, acorns, feathers, fabric
and more. (Animals not included!) The event finishes at 2.30pm. Presented
by Small World Cinema in association with
Croydon Harvest. Tickets £6.
tmdb_overview: Działania (Activities) documents a four-day action in a Warsaw television studio which can be understood as a “visual free-jazz concert,” or an attempt at interdisciplinary, collaborative improvisation. In their work, KwieKulik often attempt to mediate communication through different forms: language becomes movement, ideas transform into objects, improvisation acts as another form of theory. The surprising trajectory of these improvisations in sound, sculpture, discourse, performance and movement show the open-ended outcomes that Przemysław Kweik and Zofia Kulik were interested in pursuing during this period.

synopsis:
Bad Apples 
Genre(s): Comedy/ThrillerUSA/UK | 2025| 100 minsDirector: Jonathan EtzlerStars: Jacob Anderson, Saoirse Ronan, Robert EmmsOur Tuesday 7:30pm screening contains descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss.A blackly comic British thriller,
adapted from the Swedish novel De Oönskare (The Unwanted), and starring
Saoirse Ronan as struggling primary school teacher Maria. After a behavioural
incident on a school trip, she makes an escalating series of bad choices.
Surprised however by the knock-on effects of these decisions, the audience is
ultimately left to decide the fallout from Maria's extreme approach to
classroom management. Featuring some incredibly realistic classroom scenes and
fantastic performances from Oscar nominee Ronan and her students played by
Eddie Waller and Nia Brown, this 2025 festival favourite is a must watch this
term.
tmdb_overview: It’s Halloween night, and two “bad apples” decide to play some wicked tricks on the one house in a suburban cul-de-sac that is not celebrating Halloween. They terrorize a young couple in their home and these tricks become increasingly more sinister as the night progresses, finally ending in a Halloween the entire neighborhood will never forget.

synopsis:
Birds of War 
Genre(s): DocumentaryUK/Syria/Lebanon | 2026 | 85 mins (Arabic with English Subtitles)Directors: Janay Boulos, Abd Alkader Habak
Birds of War follows
London-based Lebanese journalist Janay Boulos and Syrian activist photographer
Abd Alkader Habak as they piece together their extraordinary long-distance
relationship through 13 years of personal footage, spanning years of
revolutions, war, displacement and exile. From the devastation of Aleppo to a
London newsroom, the film offers an intimate view of life on the frontline and
the emotional turmoil of conflict. Both a powerful documentary and a deeply
personal love story, it asks whether love can survive distance, danger,
profound change and differences. Sundance Film Festival 2026, World Cinema
Documentary Special Jury Award for Journalistic Impact. 
This work contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy.
tmdb_overview: The love story of a London-based Lebanese journalist and a Syrian activist and cameraman as told through 13 years of personal archives across revolutions, war, and exile.

synopsis:
Bitter Christmas 
Genre(s): Comedy/DramaSpain | 2025 | 111 mins (Spanish with English Subtitles)Director: Pedro AlmodóvarStars: Bárbara Lennie, Leonardo Sbaraglia, Aitana Sánchez-GijónFrom acclaimed Spanish director Pedro Almodóvar comes Bitter
Christmas. This witty and bittersweet comedy-drama intertwines the
stories of Raúl and Elsa: Raúl is a filmmaker, writing his next screenplay;
Elsa is his imaginary alter ego. As Raúl struggles with writer’s block, he
shamelessly mines the lives of the people closest to him, blurring the
boundaries between art and reality. Almodóvar’s vibrant visual style and
trademark wit create a playful, provocative portrait of love, creativity and
the stories we steal to tell our own.
tmdb_overview: In 2025 Spain, a celebrated film director struggles to write the screenplay for an autofictional film set in 2004 Spain about an unsuccessful movie director turned director of commercials who suffers a panic attack that forces her to take a break by visiting the Canary Islands, where she begins work on a new film.

synopsis:
Cactus Pears  +ShortGenre(s): DramaUK/India/Canada | 2025 | 112 mins (Marathi with English Subtitles)Director: Rohan KanawadeStars: Bhushaan Manoj, Suraaj Suman, Jayshri Jagtap, Nitin Bansode, Harish Baraskar, Ram Daund, Vidya Joshi, Hemant Kadam, Rani Kasliwal, Vaishali Kendale
Cactus Pears is a
tender and deeply personal drama set against the striking landscapes of rural
Western India. Following the death of his father, Anand returns from Mumbai to
his ancestral village to observe traditional mourning rituals. Amid mounting
family expectations to marry, he finds an unexpected refuge in Balya, a
childhood friend. As old bonds are rekindled, their connection deepens into
something more. Beautifully shot, Kanawade’s debut is a subtle, moving
exploration of grief, identity and love. Sundance Film Festival 2025 World
Cinema Grand Jury Prize winner. 
Preceded by Two Black Boys in Paradise (9 mins), a
BAFTA-winning animated short.
tmdb_overview: Anand, a 30-something city dweller compelled to spend a 10-day mourning period for his father in the rugged countryside of western India, tenderly bonds with a local farmer who is struggling to stay unmarried. As the mourning ends, forcing his return, Anand must decide the fate of his relationship born under duress.

synopsis:
Cotton Queen 
Genre(s): SUD/GER/FRA/PAL/EGY/QAT/SAU | 2025 | 93 Mins (Arabic with English Subtitles)Director: Suzannah MirghaniStars: Mihad Murtada, Rabha Mohamed Mahmoud, Talaat
Fareed
Mirghani’s
debut feature, a mixture of coming-of-age drama and post-colonial critique,
focusses on teenager Nafisa. Having grown up with her grandmother’s tales of
outsmarting the British, she works in the cotton fields of Sudan with her
friends. She is friendly with a local lad, but her mother has her sights set on
her marriage to Nadir, a British businessman eager to sell his genetically
modified cotton seed to the local farmers. Old practices such as FGM come
face-to-face with the modern world of corporate business and mobile phones in
this beautifully shot, arresting film.
Black History Month screening in conjunction with Croydon
Black History Partnership.
tmdb_overview: In a cotton-farming village in Sudan, teenage Nafisa is raised on heroic tales of battling British colonizers told by her grandmother, the village matriarch Al-Sit. But when a young businessman arrives from abroad with a new development plan and genetically engineered cotton, Nafisa becomes the center of a power play to determine the future of the village. Awakening to her own strength, Nafisa sets out to save the cotton fields – and herself. Neither she nor her community will ever be the same again.

synopsis:
Coyote Vs Acme 
Genre(s): Animation/Comedy/AdventureUSA | 2026 | 101 minsDirector: Dave GreenStars: Will Forte, Lana Condor, John CenaThis film contains flashing images which may affect viewers who are susceptible to photosensitive epilepsy.When loyal Acme
Corporation customer (and avowed enemy of Road Runner) Wile E. Coyote has
finally had enough of the company’s faulty goods, he’s left with one last
course of action: a lawsuit. Securing the services of ambulance-chasing
attorney Kevin Avery (Will Forte), the pair have to take on Acme’s hotshot
lawyer Buddy Crane (John Cena), who happens to be Avery’s former boss. Three
years after being shelved as a tax write-off by its studio, this madcap mix of
animation and live-action is seeing the light of day at long last, presenting
the world of Looney Tunes as you’ve never seen it before.
tmdb_overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

synopsis:
Dracula  & Short film
Genre: HorrorUK | 1958 | 83 minsDirector: Terence Fisher
Stars: Peter Cushing, Christopher Lee, Michael Gough

A landmark in English
Gothic horror, Dracula made Christopher Lee an international star, and caused
major American distributors to compete to release Hammer’s films. Elegant but
shocking, this first colour adaptation of Bram Stoker’s novel offered Lee’s
physicality and seductive menace, opposite Peter Cushing’s fearless Van
Helsing. Now, following the discovery of film elements in a Warner Bros.
warehouse, a brand-new restoration brings the original uncut version
(previously only seen in Japan in 1958) to UK cinemas for the first time! 

Plus
a short (10 mins) exploring the film’s restoration.
tmdb_overview: In late 15th-century Eastern Europe, Prince Vlad II’s bride is brutally murdered. As a result, he renounces God and damns Heaven itself. Cursed with eternal life, Vlad is reborn as Dracula, an immortal warlord who defies fate in a blood-soaked crusade to wrench his lost love back from death.

synopsis:
Dracula: Prince of Darkness 
Genre: HorrorUK | 1966 | 90 minsDirector: Terence FisherStars: Christopher Lee, Barbara Shelley, Andrew Keir
Transylvania, 10 years
after the events of Dracula. When four adventurous English holidaymakers fail to
heed warnings to keep well away from Dracula’s castle, they risk terrifying
consequences. This macabre sequel creates an intriguing sense of mystery, and
features the gun-toting Father Sandor (Andrew Keir) as Dracula’s primary
adversary. 

60th anniversary
presentation, in association with The Cinema Museum, of an original Technicolor
35mm ‘scope print.
tmdb_overview: Whilst vacationing in the Carpathian Mountain, two couples stumble across the remains of Count Dracula's castle. The Count's trusted servant kills one of the men, suspending the body over the Count's ashes so that the blood drips from the corpse and saturates the blackened remains. The ritual is completed, the Count revived and his attentions focus on the dead man's wife who is to become his partner; devoted to an existence of depravity and evil.

movie_title: ENGLISH NATIONAL BALLET PRESENTS THE SLEEPING BEAUTY
movie_title_en: ENGLISH NATIONAL BALLET PRESENTS THE SLEEPING BEAUTY
synopsis:
English Nation Ballet Presents Sleeping Beauty 
Genre: PerformanceUK | 2026 | 160 minsDirectors: Ross MacGibbon, Kenneth MacMillan
This classic fairytale ballet with a famous Tchaikovsky
score, is choreographed by Sir Kenneth MacMillan and filmed from a limited run
at The Royal Albert Hall. As a baby, Princess Aurora is cursed by the wicked
Carabosse: on her 16th birthday, she will prick her finger and die. Her
godmother the Lilac Fairy alters the spell so Aurora will not die, but sleep
for 100 years. Only a true love’s kiss can break the spell and awaken her. An
exquisite version of one of the world’s favourite stories. 
Tickets £15.

Hunt for the Wilderpeople 
Genre(s): Comedy/AdventureNZ | 2016 | 101 minsDirector: Taika WaititiStars: Sam Neill, Julian Dennison, Rima Te WiataTaika Waititi's quirky adventure
comedy returns to the DLC to honour the late, great Sam Neill, as well as
marking the film's 10th anniversary. After moving to rural New Zealand, Ricky -
a rebellious eleven-year-old with a passion for hip-hop - is settling into his
new life, being looked after by his loving Aunt Bella, grumpy Uncle Hec and his
dog Tupac. However, after tragedy strikes, Ricky's newfound peace is
threatened, forcing him to go on the run in the bush with his uncle. As
newly-minted outlaws, the pair face a tough choice: go out in a blaze of glory
or overcome their differences and survive as a family.
tmdb_overview: Ricky is a defiant young city kid who finds himself on the run with his cantankerous foster uncle in the wild New Zealand bush. A national manhunt ensues, and the two are forced to put aside their differences and work together to survive.

synopsis:
Late Fame 
Genre(s): Comedy/DramaUSA | 2025| 96 minsDirector: Kent JonesStars: Jake Lacy, Willem Dafoe, Greta Lee, Graham Campbell, Clark Johnson
Ed Saxberger (Willem Dafoe) is a
quiet New York post office worker who wrote a well-regarded book of poetry in
the late 1970s, before disappearing into obscurity. Decades later, a young
admirer (Edmund Donovan) tracks him down and introduces him to the “Enthusiasm
Society”, a group of privileged twenty-somethings who see Saxberger
as an overlooked literary genius from a bygone era of New York.

Flattered by their attention,
Saxberger is drawn back into the artistic world he left behind and develops a
fascination with Gloria (Greta Lee), the group’s charismatic theatrical spirit.
But as he becomes increasingly involved with his new circle, he begins to
question whether they truly admire his work or simply romanticise the idea of
the past they have created around him.
tmdb_overview: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

synopsis:
Michael 
Genres: Biography | Drama | Music2025 | USA | 127 mins Director: Antoine FuquaCast: Jaafar Jackson, Juliano Valdi, Colman Domingo, Jayden Harville
Tracing the early life and meteoric
rise of one of the most influential artists of the 20th century, Michael charts
the journey of Michael Jackson from his beginnings as the precociously talented
lead singer of the Jackson 5 to his emergence as a global superstar during the
era of his landmark Bad tour. Portrayed by his nephew Jaafar Jackson,
the film explores the ambition, creativity and pressures that shaped his
ascent. Blending intimate moments with recreations of iconic performances, it
offers a portrait of the artist behind the phenomenon — capturing both the
brilliance and the drive that defined his early career.
Black History Month

synopsis:

synopsis:

synopsis:
Pressure 
Genre(s): DramaUK/France/USA | 2026 | 100 minsDirector: Anthony Maras Stars: Andrew Scott, Brendan Fraser, Kerry Condon Our Thursday 2pm screening contains descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss and a post-screening discussion facilitated by the Croydon U3A film club. Anyone is welcome to stay behind for a fun chat.Pressure tells the
remarkable untold story behind one of the most important decisions of the
Second World War. In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, Britain’s chief
meteorological officer, Captain James Stagg (Scott), must convince Allied
commanders, including General Eisenhower (Fraser), whether the weather will
allow the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history to proceed.
With the fate of millions hanging in the balance, this is a fascinating look at
the people, decisions and the uncertainty that helped shape the course of
history. Gripping, intelligent and led by a stellar cast.
tmdb_overview: In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower and Captain James Stagg face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

synopsis:
Queen at Sea

Calder-MarshallA major prize winner at its premier at the Berlin
Film Festival, Hammer’s film follows Binoche’s mother as she decides what is

her step-father. Daughter and step-father clash over her care, while Leslie’s
condition deteriorates, and her grand-daughter looks on, demused and side-lined

Genre(s): Drama/Horror/Romance/ThrillerUK/USA | 2026 | 112 minsDirector: Jane SchoenbrunStars: Gillian Anderson, Hannah Einbinder, Patrick Fischler, Dylan Baker, Jack HavenOur 7:30pm screening includes descriptive subtitles for those with hearing loss.When up-and-coming director Kris
(Hannah Einbinder) gets the chance to reboot the long-dormant "Camp
Miasma" horror franchise, she's determined to do the series justice. Her
first step is to convince the original movie's "final girl", the
reclusive Billy Presley (Gillian Anderson) to return after decades away from
the spotlight. Winning the Queer Palm at Cannes, the third film from cult
auteur Jane Schoenbrun (I
Saw the TV Glow) is a dazzling horror romance that pays barbed
tribute to how our formative pop culture experiences can shape our lives - for
good and evil.

The Cycle of Love 
Genre(s): Documentary/Biography/Action/Adventure/Sci-FiUK/India/Sweden/USA| 2025 | 98 minsDirector: Orlando von EinsiedeStars: PK Mahanandia, Anne-Charlotte von Schedvin, Mina
Dale
In 1975, 23-year-old PK Mahanandia
makes a living drawing portraits for tourists in Delhi when he meets Lotta
(Anne-Charlotte von Schedvin), a Swedish student visiting India. Convinced
their meeting is destiny, PK recalls a childhood prophecy that he would marry a
musical woman from a far-off country, born under the sign of the ox. After
spending time together, Lotta returns to Sweden, promising to come back once
her studies are complete. But when she doesn’t return as planned and PK cannot
afford a plane ticket, he sells everything he owns, buys a second-hand bicycle
and sets off on a 6,000-mile journey across continents to find her.



Based on an extraordinary true
story, The Cycle of Love is a heart-warming tale of love, destiny
and the courage to risk everything for the person you love. Blending
documentary interviews with dramatised scenes, it’s an epic journey that we
challenge you not to shed a tear for!
tmdb_overview: Explores the romantic journey of PK Mahanandia, a Delhi street artist who trekked 6,000 miles by bicycle in 1977, venturing across continents to reunite with the woman he loved.

synopsis:
The Dresser 
Genre(s): DramaUK | 1983 | 118 minsDirector: Peter YatesStars: Albert Finney, Tom Courtenay, Edward Fox, Eileen Atkins, Betty Marsden.
Ronald Harwood adapted his own acclaimed play, which was
based on his own experiences working as a dresser for actor-manager Sir Donald
Wolfit, portrayed as ‘Sir’. Sir is leading a theatre group performing
Shakespeare in the provinces during the war, but his mental capacities are
beginning to fade, and Norman, his dresser, has the task of nursing him into
another performance of King Lear. Courtenay recreates his theatre performance
as the sensitive Norman and Finney delivers a barn-storming Sir.
A 35mm presentation in association with The Cinema Museum.
tmdb_overview: One fateful night in a small English regional theatre during World War II a troupe of touring actors stage a production of Shakespeares King Lear. Bombs are falling, sirens are wailing, the curtain is up in an hour but the actor/manager Sir who is playing Lear is nowhere to be seen. His dresser Norman must scramble to keep the production alive but will Sir turn up in time and if he does will he be able to perform that night? The Dresser is a wickedly funny and deeply moving story of friendship and loyalty as Sir reflects on his lifelong accomplishments and seeks to reconcile his turbulent friendships with those in his employ before the final curtain.

synopsis:
The Girls (Gehenu Lamai) 
Genre: DramaSri Lanka | 1978 | 110 mins (Sinhala with English Subtitles)Director: Sumitra PeriesStars: Vasanthi Chathurani, Ajith Jinadasa, Shayama AnandanThe BFI have released this
restoration of this well-loved film from 1978. Set in rural Sri Lanka, it tells
of schoolgirl Kusum, who cleans the house of a wealthy family, including their
son Nimal. He volunteers to tutor her through her exams, and although she knows
it will be frowned upon, she forms a romantic attachment to him. Meanwhile, her
younger sister Soma, enters beauty pageants and dreams of becoming a movie star
and escaping her lowly existence. Both Vasanthi Chathurani, who plays Kusum,
and director Sumitra Peries went on to have distinguished careers in Sri Lankan
cinema.

just 23 days in chronological order on 35mm film, Olivia Wilde’s all star

But when she visits the original movie’s star (Gillian Anderson), a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

Jane Schoenbrun (I Saw the TV Glow) gives us a playful open-hearted slasher about sex and cinema.

synopsis: Blending stories of home and experiences across the globe, Corina Kwami brings this to life through jazz, afro and soulful connections with the backdrop of the colour blue. Storytelling sparks reflection on the past and hope for the future. And part of listening to stories is to imagine the scenes, characters and colours that are knitted together in reflections and memories. In the tense 72 hours before D-Day, and the fate of the free world hanging in the balance, General Dwight D. Eisenhower (Brendan Fraser) and Captain James Stagg (Andrew Scott) face an impossible choice—launch the largest and most dangerous seaborne invasion in history or risk losing the war altogether.

We all know how it turned out, but PRESSURE effectively ups the dramatic stress in a chamber piece that retells a lesser known side of a monumental moment in military history.&n

synopsis:
Two star-crossed teenage boys must escape a violent entity that takes the form of the person they desire most — each other.

A haunting and sensitive feature directorial debut from writer-director Adrian Chiarella, Leviticus promises a new, poignant entry into the canon of coming-of-age horror. An isolated Australian small town hosts the evils of religious fanaticism and its consequences for queer youth, creating an atmosphere that’s chilling and near-claustroph

tmdb_original_title: La bataille de Gaulle: L'âge de fer
tmdb_overview: June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom.

Maya and her dad, Michel Gondry, live in two different countries. In order to stay in touch, her dad asks her every evening, “Maya, give me a title”. Based on her answer, he creates a short animated reply in which Maya is the hero. Michel Gondry brings to life a poetic and amusing journey that will have the little ones dreaming... and the grown-ups smiling.

After her mother dies in December, advertising director Elsa immerses herself in work to cope. When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

Wrestling with writer’s block for her first film, Bouchra, a queer Moroccan jackal living in NYC, starts having difficult yet overdue phone calls with her mother in Casablanca that begin influencing the project. Balancing the precarity of working as an artist, the rift in her cultural identity and an array of romantic interests, Bouchra’s emotional reckoning becomes her path to expression.

movie_title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
movie_title_en: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
synopsis: Former Norwich City star Tony Powell vanished from professional soccer in the 1970s. Decades later, he's found managing a West Hollywood motel, the last tenant of a disappearing place and of a life lived in secret.
tmdb_title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
tmdb_original_title: The Last Guest of the Holloway Motel
tmdb_overview: In 1970s Britain, Tony Powell was a star defender for Norwich City Football Club — until one day he disappeared from the public eye without a word to family or friends. Decades and seemingly a lifetime later, Tony now quietly resides at the Holloway Motel in the heart of West Hollywood as its manager and sole resident (apart from his dog Samantha). However, after he learns the motel is shuttering and he'll soon be evicted, Tony must finally reconcile his past and present in order to survive and come to terms with the multifaceted relationships of his life: those he's found, lost and abandoned.

Director Constantine Costi helms Verdi’s tragic masterpiece against the stunning backdrop of Sydney Harbour, starring Stacey Alleaume as the doomed courtesan Violetta alongside dashing tenor Rame Lahaj as Alfredo.  Brian Thomson’s vibrant set design features a showstopping Swarovski crystal chandelier suspended over a vast stage, perfectly evoking a whirlwind world of glamorous Parisian parties. Australian-Mauritian soprano Stacey Alleaume delivers a magnetic performance as Violetta, sharing an intense chemistry with Kosovo-born tenor Rame Lahaj as her passionate lover, Alfredo.  Conductor Brian Castles-Onion expertly guides the orchestra through the effervescent drinking song ‘Brindisi’ and the soaring emotional heights of ‘Sempre Libera’, making this a truly unforgettable evening under the stars.

Seeing Lola perform, the teacher is filled with lust, eventually resigning his position at the school to marry the young woman. However, his marriage to a coquette -- whose job is to entice men -- proves to be more difficult than Rath imagined.

movie_title: Unfaithfully Yours + Live Organ + Richard III - Monday Classic Matinee Double Bill
movie_title_en: Unfaithfully Yours + Live Organ + Richard III - Monday Classic Matinee Double Bill
synopsis:
We are delighted to welcome you back to Regent Street Cinema for a very special Monday Classic Matinee double bill celebrating two remarkable works of classic cinema.

Join us from 1:00pm, where you can enjoy tea and coffee on arrival, followed by a live organ concert and a screening of Unfaithfully Yours (1948), Preston Sturges’ brilliantly witty romantic comedy filled with sharp dialogue, misunderstandings and unforgettable Hollywood charm.

After a short interval, we will continue with Richard III (1955), Laurence Olivier’s acclaimed adaptation of Shakespeare’s iconic tragedy, featuring one of the most memorable performances in British cinema history.

From sophisticated comedy to powerful drama, this special double bill offers a wonderful opportunity to experience two very different sides of classic filmmaking, showcasing the creativity, artistry and enduring brilliance of cinema’s golden age.
A tale of the wicked deformed King and his conquests, both on the battlefield and in the boudoir.
tmdb_overview: Having helped his brother King Edward IV take the throne of England, the jealous hunchback Richard, Duke of Gloucester, plots to seize power for himself. Masterfully deceiving and plotting against nearly everyone in the royal court, including his eventual wife, Lady Anne, and his brother George, Duke of Clarence, Richard orchestrates a bloody rise to power before finding all his gains jeopardized by those he betrayed.

movie_title_en: Bohemian Rhapsody Sing-Along - 80th Birthday of Freddie Mercury
synopsis:
Everyone who gets a ticket for this celebration screening can pick up a FREE Freddie Mercury MOUSTACHE at our bar.

Additionally, all Regent Street Cinema Members attending will receive a full-size (180g) Tony's milk chocolate Popcorn Crunch bar!* 

We will also have a themed cocktail available for purchase for this special occasion, called the Bohemian Raspberry!

(*Until stock lasts)

Celebrate the life and legacy of Freddie Mercury on what would have been his 80th birthday with a special sing-a-long screening of Bohemian Rhapsody at Regent Street Cinema.

Experience Queen’s extraordinary journey, from their formation in 1970 to their show-stopping Live Aid performance, like never before. With lyrics on screen and the sound turned up, this is your chance to belt out anthems such as “Bohemian Rhapsody,” “We Will Rock You,” “Somebody to Love,” and “Don’t Stop Me Now” alongside a room full of fellow fans.

Whether you’re a lifelong Queen devotee or simply love a great night at the movies, this event promises an unforgettable celebration of music, community, and the enduring spirit of one of rock’s greatest icons.

All ages welcome. Sequins encouraged.

synopsis:
Bitter Christmas tells two alternating stories, one starring Elsa, an advertising director, in 2004, during a long weekend in December. The second takes place in 2026 and stars Raúl, a screenwriter and director who is writing a script that we soon discover is the story of Elsa, her boyfriend Bonifacio, and her friends Patricia and Natalia. Mixed with fiction, Elsa is, in a way, Raúl's alter ego, who, like him, resorts to autofiction as a solution to a long period of creative drought. He looks inside himself, and he can't help but also look at the people who make up his most intimate universe: his partner and his assistant.

The film narrates the close relationship between reality and fiction, between inspiration and life, exploring the limits of autofiction and stories within stories.
tmdb_overview: After her mother dies in December, advertising director Elsa immerses herself in work to cope. When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.

But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

movie_title: Throwback: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (Extended Edition)
movie_title_en: Throwback: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (Extended Edition)
synopsis:
Sauron's forces have laid siege to Minas Tirith, the capital of Gondor, in their efforts to eliminate the race of men. The once-great kingdom, watched over by a fading steward, has never been in more desperate need of its king. But can Aragorn answer the call of his heritage and become what he was born to be? In no small measure, the fate of Middle-earth rests on his broad shoulders. 

With the final battle joined and the legions of darkness gathering, Gandalf urgently tries to rally Gondor's broken army to action. He is aided by Rohan's King Theoden, who unites his warriors for history's biggest test. Yet even with their courage and passionate loyalty, the forces of men--with Eowyn and Merry hidden among them--are no match for the enemies swarming against Gondor. Still, in the face of great losses, they charge forward into the battle of their lifetimes, tied together by their singular goal to keep Sauron distracted and give the Ring Bearer a chance to complete his quest. 

Their hopes rest with Frodo, a tiny but determined hobbit making a perilous trip across treacherous enemy lands to cast the One Ring into the fires of Mount Doom. The closer Frodo gets to his final destination, the heavier his burden becomes and the more he must rely on Samwise Gamgee. Gollum--and the Ring itself--will test Frodo's allegiances and, ultimately, his humanity.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

movie_title_en: The Sacrifice (4K): Presented by Deeper into Movies
synopsis:
Join us for a special screening of Andrei Tarkovsky's The Sacrifice in stunning restored 4k, presented by Deeper into Movies.

Made in Sweden in Tarkovsky's final year, The Sacrifice is a measured, compassionate view of humanity at the edge of apocalypse. Photographed by Ingmar Bergman's cinematographer in ethereal northern light, the film opens and closes with two of cinema's most breathtaking single-take sequence shots.

synopsis:
Sauron's forces have laid siege to Minas Tirith, the capital of Gondor, in their efforts to eliminate the race of men. The once-great kingdom, watched over by a fading steward, has never been in more desperate need of its king. But can Aragorn answer the call of his heritage and become what he was born to be? In no small measure, the fate of Middle-earth rests on his broad shoulders. 

With the final battle joined and the legions of darkness gathering, Gandalf urgently tries to rally Gondor's broken army to action. He is aided by Rohan's King Theoden, who unites his warriors for history's biggest test. Yet even with their courage and passionate loyalty, the forces of men--with Eowyn and Merry hidden among them--are no match for the enemies swarming against Gondor. Still, in the face of great losses, they charge forward into the battle of their lifetimes, tied together by their singular goal to keep Sauron distracted and give the Ring Bearer a chance to complete his quest. 

Their hopes rest with Frodo, a tiny but determined hobbit making a perilous trip across treacherous enemy lands to cast the One Ring into the fires of Mount Doom. The closer Frodo gets to his final destination, the heavier his burden becomes and the more he must rely on Samwise Gamgee. Gollum--and the Ring itself--will test Frodo's allegiances and, ultimately, his humanity.

Screening at Screen on the Green in stunning 35mm!

movie_title: Throwback: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (Extended Edition)
movie_title_en: Throwback: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (Extended Edition)
synopsis:
Sauron's forces have laid siege to Minas Tirith, the capital of Gondor, in their efforts to eliminate the race of men. The once-great kingdom, watched over by a fading steward, has never been in more desperate need of its king. But can Aragorn answer the call of his heritage and become what he was born to be? In no small measure, the fate of Middle-earth rests on his broad shoulders. 

With the final battle joined and the legions of darkness gathering, Gandalf urgently tries to rally Gondor's broken army to action. He is aided by Rohan's King Theoden, who unites his warriors for history's biggest test. Yet even with their courage and passionate loyalty, the forces of men--with Eowyn and Merry hidden among them--are no match for the enemies swarming against Gondor. Still, in the face of great losses, they charge forward into the battle of their lifetimes, tied together by their singular goal to keep Sauron distracted and give the Ring Bearer a chance to complete his quest. 

Their hopes rest with Frodo, a tiny but determined hobbit making a perilous trip across treacherous enemy lands to cast the One Ring into the fires of Mount Doom. The closer Frodo gets to his final destination, the heavier his burden becomes and the more he must rely on Samwise Gamgee. Gollum--and the Ring itself--will test Frodo's allegiances and, ultimately, his humanity.

Screening on Sundays and Tuesdays as part of our Throwback Season where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.

movie_title: Throwback: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (Extended Edition)
movie_title_en: Throwback: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (Extended Edition)
synopsis:
Sauron's forces have laid siege to Minas Tirith, the capital of Gondor, in their efforts to eliminate the race of men. The once-great kingdom, watched over by a fading steward, has never been in more desperate need of its king. But can Aragorn answer the call of his heritage and become what he was born to be? In no small measure, the fate of Middle-earth rests on his broad shoulders. 

With the final battle joined and the legions of darkness gathering, Gandalf urgently tries to rally Gondor's broken army to action. He is aided by Rohan's King Theoden, who unites his warriors for history's biggest test. Yet even with their courage and passionate loyalty, the forces of men--with Eowyn and Merry hidden among them--are no match for the enemies swarming against Gondor. Still, in the face of great losses, they charge forward into the battle of their lifetimes, tied together by their singular goal to keep Sauron distracted and give the Ring Bearer a chance to complete his quest. 

Their hopes rest with Frodo, a tiny but determined hobbit making a perilous trip across treacherous enemy lands to cast the One Ring into the fires of Mount Doom. The closer Frodo gets to his final destination, the heavier his burden becomes and the more he must rely on Samwise Gamgee. Gollum--and the Ring itself--will test Frodo's allegiances and, ultimately, his humanity.

Screening on Sundays and Tuesdays as part of our Throwback Season where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis: In 2004, an ad director faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, a filmmaker turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and the people closest to him.
tmdb_overview: After her mother dies in December, advertising director Elsa immerses herself in work to cope. When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

synopsis: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.
tmdb_overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

synopsis: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. synopsis:
Hollywood has a monster problem…Follow the Minions in 1920s Hollywood as they aim to make a monster movie of their own and search for frightening creatures to appear in their movie.
But after unleashing monsters upon an unsuspecting world, The Minions must band together to save the day.

Fresh off the worldwide blockbuster success of summer 2024’s funniest comedy, Despicable Me 4, Illumination expands its joyful animated universe with a riotous new chapter, featuring all-new characters, in the biggest global animated franchise in history: Minions & Monsters.

This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

The acclaimed voice cast stars Coffin as the Minions, alongside Allison Janney, Christoph Waltz, Jeff Bridges, Jesse Eisenberg, Zoey Deutch, Bobby Moynihan, Phil LaMarr, and Trey Parker.
tmdb_overview: This is the rambunctious, ridiculous and totally true story of how the Minions conquered Hollywood, became movie stars, lost everything, unleashed monsters onto the world and then banded together to try and save the planet from the mayhem they had just created.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

But ACME has its own powerhouse defence attorney in Kevin’s slick nemesis Buddy Crane (John Cena), who is determined to silence Wile E. and Kevin.

Wile E. and Kevin embark on a wild quest for justice that’s as thrilling and physics-defying as Wile E.’s lifelong chase for the ever-speedy Road Runner.

tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Four lifelong friends realise that somewhere between careers, relationships, families and everyday responsibilities, they have forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. 

Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for what turns out to be an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.
tmdb_overview: Three friends go on a spa weekend that descends into chaos when their trainwreck friend joins, leading to hilarious consequences.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis: After years of slapdash sequels, the Camp Miasma franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original’s star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

synopsis: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realise her power, our world becomes their playground.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
The toys are back in Disney and Pixar’s “Toy Story 5,” and this time around it’s Toy meets Tech. 

With Woody helping abandoned toys find owners, Jessie is now the leader of Bonnie's room, with Buzz Lightyear as her second-in-command. But the gang’s jobs get exponentially harder when they go head to head with this all-new threat to playtime…a frog-like tablet named Lilypad.
tmdb_overview: When Bonnie receives a Lilypad tablet as a gift and becomes obsessed, Buzz, Woody, Jessie and the rest of the gang's jobs become exponentially harder when they have to go head to head with the all-new threat to playtime.

synopsis:
Tired from decades of being blown up by explosive ACME products whilst in pursuit of the uncatchable Road Runner, Wile E. Coyote teams up with lawyer Kevin Avery (Will Forte) to fight back in COYOTE vs. ACME. But ACME has its own powerhouse defence attorney in Kevin’s slick nemesis Buddy Crane (John Cena), who is determined to silence Wile E. and Kevin.

Wile E. and Kevin embark on a wild quest for justice that’s as thrilling and physics-defying as Wile E.’s lifelong chase for the ever-speedy Road Runner.
tmdb_overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

synopsis:
Live-action adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film 'Moana'.

An adventurous teenager sails out on a daring mission to save her people. During her journey, Moana meets the once-mighty demigod Maui, who guides her in her quest to become a master way-finder. Together they sail across the open ocean on an action-packed voyage, encountering enormous monsters and impossible odds. Along the way, Moana fulfills the ancient quest of her ancestors and discovers the one thing she always sought: her own identity.
tmdb_overview: Moana answers the Ocean's call and, for the first time, voyages beyond the reef of her island of Motunui with the infamous demigod Maui on an unforgettable journey to restore prosperity to her people.

synopsis: In 2004, an ad director faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, a filmmaker turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and the people closest to him.
tmdb_overview: After her mother dies in December, advertising director Elsa immerses herself in work to cope. When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Finding Nemo - Marlin, a clown fish, is overly cautious with his son, Nemo, who has a foreshortened fin. When Nemo swims too close to the surface to prove himself, he is caught by a diver. Horrified, Marlin must set out to find him. A blue reef fish named Dory -- who has a really short memory -- joins Marlin and complicates the encounters with sharks, jellyfish, and a host of ocean dangers. Meanwhile, Nemo plots his escape from a dentist's fish tank.

Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.
tmdb_overview: Two love-starved strangers crash into each other on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

synopsis: When fresh-faced Elliot (Hoffman) lands an exciting job for renowned artist, icon and provocateur Erika Tracy (Wilde), his fantasies come true as Erika taps him to become her sexual muse. But Elliot soon finds himself out of his depth as Erika takes him on a journey more profound than he ever could have imagined, into a world of sex, obsession, power, betrayal and murder.

synopsis: In 2004, an ad director faces a turbulent Christmas weekend. In 2026, a filmmaker turns her story into a screenplay, blurring the lines between reality, fiction, and the people closest to him.
tmdb_overview: After her mother dies in December, advertising director Elsa immerses herself in work to cope. When a panic attack forces her to take a break, she decides to travel to Lanzarote with her friend Patricia. The story of these women run parallel to that of a screenwriter and film director, exploring how life and fiction are inseparably linked, sometimes painfully so.

synopsis:
Four lifelong friends realise that somewhere between careers, relationships, families and everyday responsibilities, they have forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. 

Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for what turns out to be an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

movie_title: Throwback: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (Extended Edition)
movie_title_en: Throwback: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King (Extended Edition)
synopsis:
Sauron's forces have laid siege to Minas Tirith, the capital of Gondor, in their efforts to eliminate the race of men. The once-great kingdom, watched over by a fading steward, has never been in more desperate need of its king. But can Aragorn answer the call of his heritage and become what he was born to be? In no small measure, the fate of Middle-earth rests on his broad shoulders. 

With the final battle joined and the legions of darkness gathering, Gandalf urgently tries to rally Gondor's broken army to action. He is aided by Rohan's King Theoden, who unites his warriors for history's biggest test. Yet even with their courage and passionate loyalty, the forces of men--with Eowyn and Merry hidden among them--are no match for the enemies swarming against Gondor. Still, in the face of great losses, they charge forward into the battle of their lifetimes, tied together by their singular goal to keep Sauron distracted and give the Ring Bearer a chance to complete his quest. 

Their hopes rest with Frodo, a tiny but determined hobbit making a perilous trip across treacherous enemy lands to cast the One Ring into the fires of Mount Doom. The closer Frodo gets to his final destination, the heavier his burden becomes and the more he must rely on Samwise Gamgee. Gollum--and the Ring itself--will test Frodo's allegiances and, ultimately, his humanity.

Screening on Sundays and Tuesdays as part of our Throwback Season where we revisit classics. Each ticket to these showtimes includes complimentary popcorn and a drink.

movie_title: Soundtracking Film Club: The Death of Robin Hood + Live Q&A
movie_title_en: Soundtracking Film Club: The Death of Robin Hood + Live Q&A
synopsis:
PRESENTED BY RANGE ROVER
Join us at Everyman Borough Yards on Wednesday, 2 September, for Soundtracking Film Club, in partnership with Range Rover, for a special screening of The Death of Robin Hood. Across a series of 10 specially curated events, the partnership is formed around a shared belief in excellence, craftsmanship and the power of extraordinary experiences. 

Following the film, Edith Bowman will be joined by Jodie Comer & Michael Sarnoski to discuss the making of The Death of Robin Hood, sharing behind-the-scenes stories and insights from their experiences on set.

Set in a world of myth and consequence, The Death of Robin Hood is a darker reimagining of the classic tale. The film follows a battle‑worn Robin Hood, grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder. Gravely injured following a battle he believed would be his last, he finds himself in the hands of a mysterious woman who offers him a chance at salvation.

The Death of Robin Hood is coming to Everyman from 2 September.

synopsis: After the Trojan War, Odysseus (Matt Damon) sets out on a perilous journey home to Ithaca. Battling mythical foes including the Cyclops Polyphemus, the Sirens and the enchantress Circe, he must overcome extraordinary trials to return to everything he holds dear: his kingdom, his wife Penelope (Anne Hathaway), and his son Telemachus (Tom Holland).
tmdb_overview: Odysseus, the legendary King of Ithaca, embarks on a long and perilous journey home following the Trojan War. Throughout his voyage, he is forced to confront the whims of gods, mythological monsters, and trials that stretch both his cunning and his humanity to the breaking point.

synopsis: Spider-Man: Brand New Day marks an entirely new chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. Four years have passed since the events of No Way Home, and Peter is now an adult living entirely alone, having voluntarily erased himself from the lives and memories of those he loves. Crime-fighting in a New York that no longer knows his name, he’s devoted himself entirely to protecting his city — a full-time Spider-Man — but as the demands on him intensify, the pressure sparks a surprising physical evolution that threatens his existence, even as a strange new pattern of crimes gives rise to one of the most powerful threats he has ever faced.
tmdb_overview: Fighting crime full-time as Spider-Man in a world that doesn't remember him—and the pressure of seeing his old friends move on without him—sparks a change in Peter Parker he may not have the power to control. But that transformation might also be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city and those he loves - a powerful villain no one can even see.

synopsis:
June, 1940. France collapses and signs the armistice. In the midst of the chaos, one man refuses to give up. Alone against the odds, this unknown general flees to London to save what remains of freedom. Without an army, without backing, without hope. But with one irrational conviction -- France, his France, has not laid down arms. 

Taking the ultimate gamble, he seeks to convince the world that the battle for France is neither over, nor lost. Reality, however, is unyielding and seems determined to prove him wrong. Yet, little by little, resistance fighters, rebellious students and determined soldiers rise up in England, France and Africa to join the cause. Their faith, audacity and thirst for freedom defy what history seemed to have written in advance.

synopsis:
Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex.

Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. They both feel a spark when they meet, but a series of missteps and side quests complicate their night, keeping them apart. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

synopsis: In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realise her power, our world becomes their playground.

synopsis:
After their ship gets caught in a mysterious storm, the PAW Patrol pups crash land on an uncharted tropical island filled with dinosaurs. They meet Rex, a pup who has been stranded on the island for years and has become an expert in all things dino-related. 

When the PAW Patrol's archrival, Mayor Humdinger, begins recklessly mining in hopes of exploiting the island for its natural resources, he inadvertently causes a huge, dormant volcano to erupt. The PAW Patrol pups are thrown into a series of high-stakes, dino-sized rescues bigger than anything they've done before, as they must stop Humdinger before everything on the island goes extinct.
tmdb_overview: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

synopsis:
Tired from decades of being blown up by explosive ACME products whilst in pursuit of the uncatchable Road Runner, Wile E. Coyote teams up with lawyer Kevin Avery (Will Forte) to fight back in COYOTE vs. ACME. But ACME has its own powerhouse defence attorney in Kevin’s slick nemesis Buddy Crane (John Cena), who is determined to silence Wile E. and Kevin.

Wile E. and Kevin embark on a wild quest for justice that’s as thrilling and physics-defying as Wile E.’s lifelong chase for the ever-speedy Road Runner.
tmdb_overview: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

synopsis:
Tired from decades of being blown up by explosive ACME products whilst in pursuit of the uncatchable Road Runner, Wile E. But ACME has its own powerhouse defence attorney in Kevin’s slick nemesis Buddy Crane (John Cena), who is determined to silence Wile E. and Kevin.

Wile E. and Kevin embark on a wild quest for justice that’s as thrilling and physics-defying as Wile E.’s lifelong chase for the ever-speedy Road Runner.

synopsis:
Join us at Family Film Club, where we screen much-loved family favourites for ages 5+. Catch a movie off-peak and enjoy half-price kids' tickets. The perfect way to enjoy a cinema outing together as a family.

This week, grab your popcorn and save a sofa for Finding Nemo - Marlin, a clown fish, is overly cautious with his son, Nemo, who has a foreshortened fin. When Nemo swims too close to the surface to prove himself, he is caught by a diver. Horrified, Marlin must set out to find him. A blue reef fish named Dory -- who has a really short memory -- joins Marlin and complicates the encounters with sharks, jellyfish, and a host of ocean dangers. Meanwhile, Nemo plots his escape from a dentist's fish tank.
